theory_query: Build theories of how the choice of method (Tersoff and Stillinger-Weber empirical potentials in molecular dynamics, Green-Kubo or nonequilibrium MD, first-principles phonon Boltzmann transport with DFT force constants) changes the predicted lattice thermal conductivity of crystalline silicon, germanium and Si1-xGex, as a function of temperature.
mission_statement:
The theories will be used to answer the following questions before the corresponding simulation results are seen. Address the mechanisms they depend on:


H5. Pure crystalline Si: Tersoff-1989 GPUMD homogeneous NEMD kappa versus
almaBTE (160.5 W/mK at 300 K, 40.5 W/mK at 1100 K).
Value: ratio Tersoff/almaBTE at 300 K. Category for 1100 K:
"agree within 30 %", "Tersoff higher by more than 30 %",
"Tersoff lower by more than 30 %".
